name: Adam Frank
abstract_title: Qi as A Problem of Consciousness
abstract: This paper first connects the concept of qi with theories of consciousness from neuroscientific and philosophical perspectives. Then, adopting a discourse-centered approach to analyzing the many contexts in which qi is written about, discussed, and experienced, the paper makes the case that the concept of qi reflects deeply held human understandings of experience that arise from attention to both the external environment and the internal landscape of the body.
